svg.title: The Ring Door: Dendrochronology letterpress
svg.desc: The Ring Door (1D): the knot face printed like a cross-section of a tree, four rings of growth lines around a heart. A crack runs straight up from the centre: the line. Two rings already have their grain notch on it; the player turns the third clockwise, and the arrows show the ring inside it turning back the other way, because the rings are linked. The margins count moves against par and list the glyphs revealed so far.
